# 00000004707

**EC4-17 ◆** — source: 142_遍历论的组合_熵与计数.md

**English.** Definition: A nilpotent system is a flow of rotations of a nilpotent group. Conjecture: The order-four characteristic factor is an explicit four-step nilpotent flow, the phases are generated by cubic bracket polynomials, and the factor is unique up to isomorphism. (uniqueness of the four-step nilpotent characteristic factor)

**中文。** 定义：幂零系统指幂零群旋转流。猜想：四阶的特征因子为显式四步幂零流,相位由三次括号多项式生成且因子在同构意义下唯一。（四步幂零特征因子唯一）
